_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-21. src/already-awaited.ts ALREADY awaits migrationRunner, so the no-op guard's job is to drop a 'missing await' finding whose suggested fix is the code that is already there (the PR #31 false positive). Asserted as `critical: 0` rather than by string-matching the finding text, so it does not depend on the model's wording. It is not deterministic, though: any other real critical the model finds in the diff also fails it, so it is labelled `model` (mergewatch.ai#660). The log-line outcome ('dropped by the no-op guard') is not machine-checkable — grade-run reads GitHub, not CloudWatch.
_variance: One-sided on the no-op guard, but any other real critical the model finds in the diff also fails critical: 0.
